description: Angular component for configuring a compass gauge widget, including form setup, validation, and configuration handling.

classes.name: CompassGaugeBasicConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component extending BasicWidgetConfigComponent for compass gauge widget configuration.

methods.name: displayTimewindowConfig
methods.description: Getter that determines if the timewindow configuration should be displayed based on datasources.

methods.name: onlyHistoryTimewindow
methods.description: Checks if only comparison aggregation datasources are used.

methods.name: configForm
methods.description: Returns the form group used for configuration.

methods.name: onConfigSet
methods.description: Initializes the form with provided configuration data.

methods.name: prepareOutputConfig
methods.description: Prepares and saves the configuration data from the form.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns form control names that trigger validation updates.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Enables or disables form controls based on other control values.

methods.name: getCardButtons
methods.description: Determines which card buttons should be enabled based on widget config.

methods.name: setCardButtons
methods.description: Sets the enableFullscreen property based on selected buttons.
